nodes.summary: Equal normal closures forcing conjugacy does not make the derived subgroup of a finite $2$-group abelian (Kourovka 12.15). There exists a finite $2$-group $G$ in which any two elements with the same normal closure are conjugate, but whose derived subgroup $G'$ is not abelian.
nodes.title: Equal normal closures forcing conjugacy does not make the derived subgroup of a finite $2$-group abelian (Kourovka 12.15)

nodes.summary: Golikova–Starostin question on finite $2$-groups in which normal closures determine conjugacy (Kourovka 12.15). The statement that for every finite $2$-group $G$ in which any two elements with the same normal closure are conjugate, the derived subgroup $G'$ of $G$ is abelian.
nodes.title: Golikova–Starostin question on finite $2$-groups in which normal closures determine conjugacy (Kourovka 12.15)
